description: Web data platform offering proxies, scraper APIs, SERP API, Web Unlocker and datasets.
auth_notes: Bright Data API key sent as Authorization: Bearer header; obtained from account settings.
gate_detail: Every signup gets a free trial and a recurring 5,000 credits per month free tier. Personal-email accounts without a payment method are restricted from Proxy Networks and Web Unlocker until a no-charge verification payment method is added.
api_scope: REST APIs for Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, Browser API and datasets, plus Account Management API (e.g. pricing plans); docs also reference a CLI.
mcp_notes: Bright Data MCP server documented on docs.brightdata.com with hosted and self-hosted modes; needs a Bright Data API key.
blocker_detail: Some products need a payment method for verification only; no approval or sales gate.

evidence.quote: Use your Bright Data API Key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Obtain your API Key from the Bright Data account settings at https://brightdata.com/cp/setting/users
Everyone who signs up to Bright Data automatically gets a free trial, which can be used for all Bright Data products.
Every new account also gets a recurring free tier of 5,000 credits per month for the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API
Browser control tools are enabled by default. All you need is your Bright Data API key

uncertainties: MCP server URL not stated in sources.
Payment verification requirement applies to personal-email accounts for some products.
